name: Our Forever, Laid to Rest
overview:
It tells the story of Qiao Ruo Li, whose parents’ drunk driving causes Pei Xu Bai’s family to be destroyed. In order to atone, she stays by his side for five years, only to endure suffering and hardship. After they part ways, they reunite again due to the entanglements of fate.

(Source: Chinese = Baidu || Translation = MyDramaList)
